labels.shippable: 基地可用库存与日均需求

notes.demand-accuracy: 仅从业务库同步的指定需求准确率表读取。原表为空时保持缺失，不使用预测总量代替。
notes.sales-accuracy: 业务库同步的原始销售计划准确率；初始和调整偏差量分别汇总后除以对应计划量，再取两种准确率均值。月中只反映当前源累计状态。
notes.delivery-daily: 业务库同步日发货；按实际发货日筛选，act_dl_qty 与 act_dl_qty_all 分列，未税收入与财务月收入独立核对，不混加。
notes.finance: 财务未税本币收入；月度事实仅支持完整历史月份或今天截止的当前月/年，不支持历史月中与日周切片。源更新时间见明细；不按日摊分。
notes.sales-budget: 客户预算先独立按月份和组织汇总，不与商品销售明细关联，避免重复预算；整月预算不按日摊分。
notes.forecast-products: 与销售预测相同期间和版本，按品类/品项/物料组聚合；用于产品下钻，不与销售预测相加。
notes.orders-products: 与缺货供需匹配事实使用相同订单新增期间，按品类/品项/系列聚合；替代对应产品视图，不与订单履约相加。
notes.shippable: 基地可用库存与同日、同基地、同SKU计划日均需求匹配汇总。
notes.pending: 最新备单快照，按仓库和阶段展示订单量及占用量；不将订单量与占用量相加。
notes.branchplans: 最新分仓计划快照，按月份/版本/状态分别展示；预算金额不在SKU行上重复累计。
notes.stock: 按所选版本、截止日最近快照和对应目标月读取。基地库存不与分仓/货龄库存重复相加。品项/物料组按同截止日前最新订单字典唯一匹配，分类不全的下钻不输出部分合计。
notes.orders: 读取已同步的缺货供需匹配快照，按订单新增时间筛选，并按 source_rows 还原重复记录权重。沿用订单量或需求量大于0的口径；缺货量取 final_short_qty，满足率=1-缺货量/原始需求量。源表不含销售组，销售组下钻保持未知。
notes.forecast: 月度数据；月初或纠偏，is_split=1；源表月份/类型/客户/SKU唯一键保证每个业务键只有一行。不把计划执行率视为预测准确率。
notes.execution: 源记录键为业务日/客户/SKU及组织维度，属于按业务键更新数据；保留各行来源日期，不用全局最新快照截断未更新行。计划量在月首行，发货量是业务日发生量。历史是当前已同步记录的回看。
notes.production: 计划完工日在选定日期起连续7个自然日（含当日）的现有计划；只有计划量，缺生产实绩，不能计算达成率。
notes.branch: 最新分仓库存快照；不与基地或货龄数量相加。
notes.budget: 仅分仓提货点预算，每月/提货点一条；不代表全公司预算。空预算保持未知。
notes.operations: 数量/金额事实按各指标独立展示，排除不可加总的考核比率；不同指标禁止再相加。
notes.plans: 读取业务库已同步的原始销售提报；品类按原始商品字典的唯一SKU分类匹配，物料组保持原字段；整月计划不与月中实绩计算最终准确率。
notes.age: 以数量加权货龄；大日期阈值180天，仅作为观察项。

demand-accuracy.sql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYYMM') AS month,belong_name AS base,product_categ_name AS category,material_group_name AS material,
SUM(current_month_estimate*source_rows) AS initial_plan,SUM(current_month_adjust*source_rows) AS adjusted_plan,
SUM(estimate_deviation_qty*source_rows) AS initial_deviation,SUM(adjust_deviation_qty*source_rows) AS adjusted_deviation,
SUM(act_dl_qty*source_rows) AS actual,SUM(source_rows) AS records,
SUM(CASE WHEN act_dl_qty IS NULL OR act_dl_qty<0 THEN source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS missing_actual,
SUM(CASE WHEN current_month_estimate IS NULL OR current_month_adjust IS NULL OR estimate_deviation_qty IS NULL OR adjust_deviation_qty IS NULL OR current_month_estimate<0 OR current_month_adjust<0 THEN source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
FROM agents_scm_demand_accuracy WHERE month BETWEEN CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
GROUP BY month,belong_name,product_categ_name,material_group_name

branch.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_branch_inventory_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE))
SELECT s.warehouseid AS warehouse,s.warehouse_name AS name,s.base_name AS base,s.product_categ_name AS category,
 SUM(s.live_qty) AS inventory,SUM(s.available_qty) AS available,COUNT(*) AS records,MAX(s.snapshot_date) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_branch_inventory_snapshot AS s INNER JOIN latest AS l ON s.snapshot_date=l.at
GROUP BY s.warehouseid,s.warehouse_name,s.base_name,s.product_categ_name
ORDER BY s.warehouseid,s.warehouse_name,s.base_name,s.product_categ_name

plans-source-year.sql:
SELECT MIN(p.month) AS month,
 p.base AS base,
 p.category AS category,
 p.region AS region,
 p.province AS province,
 p.sales_group AS sales_group,
 SUM(p.planned) AS planned,
 SUM(p.initial_plan) AS initial_plan,
 SUM(p.records) AS records,
 SUM(p.missing_plan) AS missing_plan,
 MAX(p.source_date) AS source_date
FROM agents_aps_plans_source AS p
WHERE p.month BETWEEN :gea_p1 AND :gea_p2
GROUP BY p.base,p.category,p.region,p.province,p.sales_group
ORDER BY p.base,p.category,p.region,p.province,p.sales_group

orders-products.sql:
SELECT s.pickup_point_desc_short_form AS base,s.product_categ_name AS category,s.pinxiang AS item,s.xilie AS material,
 SUM(s.need_qty_origin*s.source_rows) AS demand,SUM(s.final_short_qty*s.source_rows) AS shortage,
 SUM(s.out_order_qty*s.source_rows) AS shipped,SUM(s.source_rows) AS records,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.need_qty_origin IS NULL OR s.final_short_qty IS NULL OR s.need_qty_origin<0 OR s.final_short_qty<0 THEN s.source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS invalid,
 MIN(s.addtime) AS first_snapshot,MAX(s.complete_time) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_shortage_supply_match AS s
WHERE s.addtime>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
 AND s.addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)+INTERVAL '1 day'
 AND (s.order_qty_origin>0 OR s.need_qty_origin>0)
GROUP BY s.pickup_point_desc_short_form,s.product_categ_name,s.pinxiang,s.xilie
ORDER BY s.pickup_point_desc_short_form,s.product_categ_name,s.pinxiang,s.xilie

operations.sql:
SELECT metric_group AS metric_group,metric_name AS metric,period_month AS month,
 SUM(metric_value) AS value,COUNT(*) AS records,MIN(snapshot_date) AS first_snapshot,MAX(snapshot_date) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_branch_operation_fact
WHERE period_month BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('month',CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)) AND CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 AND snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 AND metric_group<>:gea_p3
GROUP BY metric_group,metric_name,period_month ORDER BY metric_group,metric_name,period_month

production.sql:
SELECT base_finish_date AS date,base_name AS base,warehouse_group_name AS pickup,
 material_code AS sku,SUM(planned_qty) AS planned,COUNT(*) AS records,MAX(updated_time) AS source_date

forecast.sql:
-- Valid unique index forecast_month_type_dealer_sku_key enforces one row per month/type/dealer/SKU.
-- Keep NULL-key/time exclusion from the previous MAX-and-join query.
SELECT f.plan_month AS month,f.belong_base AS base,f.product_categ_name AS category,
 f.region_name AS region,f.province_region_name AS province,f.sales_group_name AS sales_group,
 COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(CASE WHEN f.predicted_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN f.predicted_quantity WHEN f.predicted_sales_amount=0 AND f.landed_price_excl_tax>0 THEN 0 ELSE NULL END) AS predicted,SUM(f.actual_sales_quantity) AS actual,
 SUM(f.predicted_sales_amount) AS predicted_amount,SUM(f.actual_sales_amount) AS actual_amount,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.actual_sales_quantity IS NULL) AS missing_actual,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.predicted_quantity IS NULL AND (f.predicted_sales_amount IS NULL OR f.landed_price_excl_tax IS NULL OR f.predicted_sales_amount<>0 OR f.landed_price_excl_tax<=0)) AS missing_predicted,MAX(f.created_at) AS source_date
FROM agents_sales_forecast_detail_mi AS f
WHERE f.plan_month BETWEEN :gea_p1 AND :gea_p2
 AND f.order_type=:gea_p3 AND f.is_split=1
 AND f.dealer_code IS NOT NULL AND f.sku_code IS NOT NULL AND f.created_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.plan_month,f.belong_base,f.product_categ_name,f.region_name,f.province_region_name,f.sales_group_name
ORDER BY f.plan_month,f.belong_base,f.product_categ_name,f.region_name,f.province_region_name,f.sales_group_name

budget.sql:
SELECT year_month AS month,shipping_code AS code,shipping_name AS name,budget_mny AS budget,
 pre_mny AS previous,ly_same_mny AS last_year,data_status AS status,calculation_date AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_branch_budget_monthly WHERE year_month BETWEEN :gea_p1 AND :gea_p2
ORDER BY year_month,shipping_code

branchplans.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(plan_snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_branch_plan WHERE plan_snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE))
SELECT p.target_month AS month,p.branch_pickup_point AS code,p.branch_name AS name,p.product_categ_name AS category,
 p.plan_version AS version,p.plan_status AS status,SUM(p.shipment_plan_qty) AS planned,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.shipment_plan_qty IS NULL) AS missing_plan,COUNT(*) AS records,MAX(p.plan_snapshot_date) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_branch_plan AS p INNER JOIN latest AS l ON p.plan_snapshot_date=l.at
WHERE p.target_month BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('month',CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)) AND CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
GROUP BY p.target_month,p.branch_pickup_point,p.branch_name,p.product_categ_name,p.plan_version,p.plan_status
ORDER BY p.target_month,p.branch_pickup_point,p.branch_name,p.product_categ_name,p.plan_version,p.plan_status

pending.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(source_snapshot_time) AS at FROM agents_scm_branch_pending_order WHERE source_snapshot_time<CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)+INTERVAL '1 day')
SELECT p.base_name AS base,p.inventory_scope AS scope,p.warehouseid AS warehouse,p.order_stage AS stage,
 SUM(p.order_qty) AS ordered,SUM(p.allocated_qty) AS allocated,COUNT(*) AS records,MAX(p.source_snapshot_time) AS source_date

age.sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_inventory_age WHERE snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE))
SELECT s.base_name AS base,s.product_categ_name AS category,SUM(s.qty) AS quantity,
 SUM(s.qty*s.productage) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.productage>:gea_p2 THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) AS older_quantity,
 COUNT(*) AS records,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.productage IS NULL OR s.qty IS NULL) AS invalid,MAX(s.snapshot_date) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_inventory_age AS s INNER JOIN latest AS l ON s.snapshot_date=l.at
GROUP BY s.base_name,s.product_categ_name ORDER BY s.base_name,s.product_categ_name

forecast-products.sql:
WITH material_latest AS (
 SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_order_fulfillment WHERE snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
), material_dim AS (
 SELECT LTRIM(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'0') AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_categ_name)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.product_categ_name,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.product_categ_name) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.pinxiang)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.pinxiang,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.pinxiang) END AS item,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.material_group_name)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.material_group_name,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.material_group_name) END AS material
 FROM agents_scm_order_fulfillment AS f INNER JOIN material_latest AS d ON f.snapshot_date=d.at
 WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY LTRIM(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'0')
), material_groups AS (
 SELECT material AS material,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT category)=1 AND COUNT(category)=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(category) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT item)=1 AND COUNT(item)=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(item) END AS item
 FROM material_dim WHERE material IS NOT NULL GROUP BY material
)

-- Valid unique index forecast_month_type_dealer_sku_key enforces one row per month/type/dealer/SKU.
-- Keep NULL-key/time exclusion from the previous MAX-and-join query.
SELECT f.plan_month AS month,f.belong_base AS base,f.product_categ_name AS category,
 COALESCE(m.item,g.item) AS item,f.material_group_name AS material,
 COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(CASE WHEN f.predicted_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN f.predicted_quantity WHEN f.predicted_sales_amount=0 AND f.landed_price_excl_tax>0 THEN 0 ELSE NULL END) AS predicted,SUM(f.actual_sales_quantity) AS actual,
 SUM(f.predicted_sales_amount) AS predicted_amount,SUM(f.actual_sales_amount) AS actual_amount,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.actual_sales_quantity IS NULL) AS missing_actual,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.predicted_quantity IS NULL AND (f.predicted_sales_amount IS NULL OR f.landed_price_excl_tax IS NULL OR f.predicted_sales_amount<>0 OR f.landed_price_excl_tax<=0)) AS missing_predicted,MAX(f.created_at) AS source_date
FROM agents_sales_forecast_detail_mi AS f LEFT JOIN material_dim AS m ON LTRIM(TRIM(CAST(f.sku_code AS TEXT)),'0')=m.sku AND f.product_categ_name=m.category
LEFT JOIN material_groups AS g ON f.material_group_name=g.material AND f.product_categ_name=g.category
WHERE f.plan_month BETWEEN :gea_p2 AND :gea_p3
 AND f.order_type=:gea_p4 AND f.is_split=1
 AND f.dealer_code IS NOT NULL AND f.sku_code IS NOT NULL AND f.created_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.plan_month,f.belong_base,f.product_categ_name,COALESCE(m.item,g.item),f.material_group_name
ORDER BY f.plan_month,f.belong_base,f.product_categ_name,COALESCE(m.item,g.item),f.material_group_name

stock.sql:
WITH material_latest AS (
 SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_order_fulfillment WHERE snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
), material_dim AS (
 SELECT LTRIM(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'0') AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_categ_name)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.product_categ_name,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.product_categ_name) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.pinxiang)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.pinxiang,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.pinxiang) END AS item,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.material_group_name)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.material_group_name,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.material_group_name) END AS material
 FROM agents_scm_order_fulfillment AS f INNER JOIN material_latest AS d ON f.snapshot_date=d.at
 WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY LTRIM(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'0')
), material_groups AS (
 SELECT material AS material,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT category)=1 AND COUNT(category)=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(category) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT item)=1 AND COUNT(item)=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(item) END AS item
 FROM material_dim WHERE material IS NOT NULL GROUP BY material
)
, latest AS (
 SELECT MAX(inventory_snapshot_time) AS at FROM agents_scm_safety_stock
 WHERE inventory_snapshot_time < CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 day' AND inventory_version = :gea_p2
), stock_month AS (
 SELECT MIN(s.target_month) AS month
 FROM agents_scm_safety_stock AS s INNER JOIN latest AS l ON s.inventory_snapshot_time=l.at
 WHERE s.inventory_version=:gea_p2
), scoped AS (
 SELECT s.base_name AS base, s.product_categ_name AS category, s.material_code AS sku, m.item AS item,m.material AS material,
 s.current_inventory AS inventory, s.avg_daily_planned_demand AS demand, s.final_target_inventory AS target,
 s.inventory_snapshot_time AS at,s.target_month AS target_month
 FROM agents_scm_safety_stock AS s INNER JOIN latest AS l ON s.inventory_snapshot_time=l.at CROSS JOIN stock_month AS sm
 LEFT JOIN material_dim AS m ON LTRIM(CAST(s.material_code AS TEXT),'0')=m.sku AND s.product_categ_name=m.category
 WHERE s.inventory_version=:gea_p2 AND s.target_month=sm.month
)
SELECT base AS base,category AS category,item AS item,material AS material,COUNT(*) AS records, CASE WHEN COUNT(inventory)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(inventory) END AS inventory,
 SUM(demand) AS demand,SUM(target) AS target,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE demand IS NULL OR demand<0) AS missing_demand,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE target IS NULL) AS missing_target, MAX(at) AS source_date,MAX(target_month) AS target_month
FROM scoped GROUP BY base,category,item,material ORDER BY base,category,item,material

execution.sql:
SELECT stat_month AS month,belong_base AS base,product_categ_name AS category,
 region_name AS region,province_region_name AS province,sales_group_name AS sales_group,
 SUM(allnum) AS planned,SUM(plannum) AS initial_plan,SUM(act_dl_qty) AS actual,
 SUM(order_qty_origin) AS ordered,COUNT(*) AS records,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE allnum IS NULL OR act_dl_qty IS NULL) AS invalid,
 MIN(snapshot_date) AS first_snapshot,MAX(snapshot_date) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_cust_plan_exe
WHERE stat_month BETWEEN :gea_p1 AND :gea_p2 AND stat_date<=CAST(:gea_p3 AS DATE)
 AND stat_date>=CAST(:gea_p4 AS DATE)
GROUP BY stat_month,belong_base,product_categ_name,region_name,province_region_name,sales_group_name
ORDER BY stat_month,belong_base,product_categ_name,region_name,province_region_name,sales_group_name

shippable.sql:
WITH material_latest AS (
 SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_order_fulfillment WHERE snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
), material_dim AS (
 SELECT LTRIM(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'0') AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_categ_name)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.product_categ_name,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.product_categ_name) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.pinxiang)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.pinxiang,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.pinxiang) END AS item,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.material_group_name)=1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(f.material_group_name,''))=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(f.material_group_name) END AS material
 FROM agents_scm_order_fulfillment AS f INNER JOIN material_latest AS d ON f.snapshot_date=d.at
 WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'') IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY LTRIM(TRIM(f.new_material_code),'0')
), material_groups AS (
 SELECT material AS material,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT category)=1 AND COUNT(category)=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(category) END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT item)=1 AND COUNT(item)=COUNT(*) THEN MAX(item) END AS item
 FROM material_dim WHERE material IS NOT NULL GROUP BY material
)
, stock_date AS (
 SELECT MAX(s.inventory_snapshot_time) AS at FROM agents_scm_safety_stock AS s
 WHERE s.inventory_snapshot_time < CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)+INTERVAL '1 day' AND s.inventory_version=:gea_p2
), stock_month AS (
 SELECT MIN(s.target_month) AS month
 FROM agents_scm_safety_stock AS s INNER JOIN stock_date AS d ON s.inventory_snapshot_time=d.at
 WHERE s.inventory_version=:gea_p2
), demand AS (
 SELECT s.base_name AS base,LTRIM(TRIM(CAST(s.material_code AS TEXT)),'0') AS sku,
 SUM(s.avg_daily_planned_demand) AS daily,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL OR s.avg_daily_planned_demand<0) AS invalid
 FROM agents_scm_safety_stock AS s INNER JOIN stock_date AS d ON s.inventory_snapshot_time=d.at CROSS JOIN stock_month AS sm
 WHERE s.inventory_version=:gea_p2 AND s.target_month=sm.month
 GROUP BY s.base_name,LTRIM(TRIM(CAST(s.material_code AS TEXT)),'0')
), available_date AS (
 SELECT MAX(o.snapshot_date) AS at FROM agents_scm_branch_operation_fact AS o
 WHERE o.metric_group='base_supply' AND o.metric_name='base_available_qty' AND o.snapshot_date<=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
), available AS (
 SELECT o.base_group_name AS base,LTRIM(TRIM(o.material_code),'0') AS sku,SUM(o.metric_value) AS available,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.metric_value IS NULL OR o.metric_value<0) AS invalid,MAX(o.snapshot_date) AS source_date
 FROM agents_scm_branch_operation_fact AS o INNER JOIN available_date AS d ON o.snapshot_date=d.at
 WHERE o.metric_group='base_supply' AND o.metric_name='base_available_qty'
 GROUP BY o.base_group_name,LTRIM(TRIM(o.material_code),'0')
), keys AS (
 SELECT d.base AS base,d.sku AS sku FROM demand AS d
 UNION ALL
 SELECT a.base AS base,a.sku AS sku FROM available AS a LEFT JOIN demand AS d ON d.base=a.base AND d.sku=a.sku WHERE d.sku IS NULL
)
SELECT k.base AS base,m.category AS category,m.item AS item,m.material AS material,SUM(a.available) AS available,SUM(d.daily) AS demand,COUNT(*) AS records,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.sku IS NULL OR d.sku IS NULL OR a.invalid>0 OR d.invalid>0 OR a.source_date<>CAST(sd.at AS DATE)) AS invalid,
 MAX(a.source_date) AS source_date
FROM keys AS k LEFT JOIN available AS a ON k.base=a.base AND k.sku=a.sku
LEFT JOIN demand AS d ON k.base=d.base AND k.sku=d.sku CROSS JOIN stock_date AS sd
LEFT JOIN material_dim AS m ON k.sku=m.sku
GROUP BY k.base,m.category,m.item,m.material ORDER BY k.base,m.category,m.item,m.material

orders-month-products.sql:
SELECT s.pickup_point_desc_short_form AS base,s.product_categ_name AS category,s.pinxiang AS item,s.xilie AS material,
 SUM(s.need_qty_origin*s.source_rows) AS demand,SUM(s.final_short_qty*s.source_rows) AS shortage,
 SUM(s.out_order_qty*s.source_rows) AS shipped,SUM(s.source_rows) AS records,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.need_qty_origin IS NULL OR s.final_short_qty IS NULL OR s.need_qty_origin<0 OR s.final_short_qty<0 THEN s.source_rows ELSE 0 END) AS invalid,
 MIN(s.addtime) AS first_snapshot,MAX(s.complete_time) AS source_date
FROM agents_scm_shortage_supply_match AS s
WHERE s.addtime>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE)
 AND s.addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)+INTERVAL '1 day'
 AND (s.order_qty_origin>0 OR s.need_qty_origin>0)
GROUP BY s.pickup_point_desc_short_form,s.product_categ_name,s.pinxiang,s.xilie
ORDER BY s.pickup_point_desc_short_form,s.product_categ_name,s.pinxiang,s.xilie
